clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Dwarven Tinder gives Alliance saboteurs a way to burn Dragonmaw siege engines before they reach Menethil Harbor.

When Alliance scouts found Chieftain Nek'rosh's heavy catapults inside the Dragonmaw encampment, Menethil Harbor faced a crisis. Fighting in Dun Algaz had cut off the harbor from southern reinforcements, and its defenders could not withstand a long siege. They chose to sabotage the catapults before they could be used. Volunteers carrying Dwarven Tinder into orcish territory could light it with a struck spark. Its flames burned through the reinforced wooden engines in minutes.
